Coastal Cave of Dawn.description: Soft ocean winds drift through the cave entrance. Ancient carvings of Maui line the walls while distant waves echo beneath the cliffs.

Lava Tunnel of Echoes.description: Torchlight flickers across black lava stone. The air carries the scent of sulfur, and old chants seem to linger in the darkness.

Ruins near Honu Bay.description: Broken temple stones rest beneath creeping vines. Legends of Kāmohoaliʻi are etched into weathered pillars facing the sea.

Temple of Moon Tides.description: Moonlight filters through cracks in the ceiling. Ancient offerings surround a stone altar dedicated to spirits of the ocean.

Cavern beyond Banyans.description: Damp stone walls shimmer with moisture. Faint whispers tell stories of wandering Nightmarchers crossing hidden paths.

Volcanic Hall of Pele.description: Rivers of glowing magma illuminate the chamber. The presence of Pele feels close as heat radiates from every surface.

Sanctum under Haleakala.description: Ancient volcanic stone forms a sacred chamber beneath the mountain. Symbols of Maui circle a pedestal where a legendary relic rests. The legendary Maui Stone radiates power before you.
